label: IGH / MYC

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
MYC encodes a transcription factor that controls cellular growth and metabolism.

The rearrangement places MYC under immunoglobulin regulatory control, increasing MYC expression and proliferative transcription. It is characteristic of Burkitt lymphoma but also occurs in other B-cell neoplasms.
